items.title: Factory brings autonomous coding work into Jira
items.summary: Factory and Atlassian have unlocked something big for our shared customers: Factory’s Droid coding agent can now be invoked directly from a Jira work item. Droid picks up the task, runs the engineering work in the selected environment, and writes results back to Jira.
